item.title: 英特尔代工获微软下一代AI芯片订单，将采用18A工艺
item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: 'Rainbow-on-a-chip' could help unlock 6G networks and precision timing for quantum technologies
item.description: Loughborough University physicists and an international team have demonstrated that a grain-of-rice-sized microchip can be used to produce a spectrum of precisely spaced frequencies of light, which is then converted into multiple high-frequency electromagnetic signals known as millimeter waves.
